sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.StoreCode AS storeCode, COUNT(t.categoryId) AS categoryCount, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos1 THEN t.name END) AS category1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos1 THEN t.code END) AS category1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos1 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category1Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos2 THEN t.name END) AS category2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos2 THEN t.code END) AS category2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos2 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category2Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos3 THEN t.name END) AS category3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos3 THEN t.code END) AS category3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos3 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category3Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos4 THEN t.name END) AS category4Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos4 THEN t.code END) AS category4Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos4 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category4Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos5 THEN t.name END) AS category5Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos5 THEN t.code END) AS category5Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos5 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category5Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos6 THEN t.name END) AS category6Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos6 THEN t.code END) AS category6Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos6 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category6Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos7 THEN t.name END) AS category7Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos7 THEN t.code END) AS category7Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos7 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category7Id, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos8 THEN t.name END) AS category8Name, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos8 THEN t.code END) AS category8Code, MAX(CASE WHEN t.position = @pos8 THEN t.categoryId END) AS category8Id FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p INNER JOIN (SELECT pc.PortalId AS portalId, c.ZnodeCategoryId AS categoryId, c.Name AS name, c.CategoryCode AS code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.PortalId ORDER BY c.DisplayOrder, c.ZnodeCategoryId) AS position FROM dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = c.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = c.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE v.RevisionType = @revisionType AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND c.ZnodeParentCategoryIds IS NULL AND (c.ActivationDate IS NULL OR c.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (c.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR c.ExpirationDate >= @now)) t ON t.portalId = p.PortalId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.StoreCode = @preferred) GROUP BY p.PortalId, p.StoreCode HAVING COUNT(t.categoryId) >= @minCategories ORDER BY p.PortalId
